per_case_results.actual_sql:

    CAST("male_count" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("female_count", 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio",

        SUM(CASE WHEN "g"."gender" = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "female_count"
    FROM "superhero" "s"
    INNER JOIN "gender" "g" ON "s"."gender_id" = "g"."id"
) AS counts
LIMIT 500
